slides.title: Q3 2026 Retro Recap
slides.subtitle: What shipped, what moved, and what's next for the team
slides.notes: This deck recaps the Q3 2026 team retro for anyone who wasn't in the room. It should stand on its own - no extra context needed.

slides.title: What happened this quarter
bullets: Shipped the new onboarding flow - live since August 2026
Added one more person to the support team
Grew the overall team from 7 to 9 people
slides.notes: Source note originally logged the onboarding launch as a Q2 ship, then self-corrected: it went live in August 2026, which is Q3. Using Q3 throughout this deck.

slides.title: Support ticket volume is down sharply
slides.takeaway: The new onboarding flow (live since August) plus one additional support hire drove the roughly 30% drop in ticket volume.
slides.notes: 412 -> 290 is a 29.6% decrease, rounded to ~30% per the retro notes.

slides.title: Team growth and customer sentiment
slides.takeaway: Headcount grew from 7 to 9 this quarter. Q3 NPS is marked TBD: the retro notes logged it as flat at 31, but the note-taker flagged that as likely wrong and couldn't confirm the real number (possibly ~38) without dashboard access - we'll update this once it's verified.
slides.notes: Do not present 38 as confirmed - the author explicitly said they'd need to check the dashboard. This differs from the onboarding-date issue, which the notes resolved themselves; this one stays an open item.

slides.title: Q4 2026 goals
bullets: Get support tickets under 250 for the quarter
